outcome: gray matter volume (GMV) of superior temporal gyri (STG)
proportion of looking at faces and mouths
cohort: The study curated data from 569 toddlers approximately 18 months of age, comprising 76 with preterm birth and 493 with term birth, from the developing Human Connectome Project.
finding: Preterm birth was associated with higher gray matter volume in bilateral superior temporal gyri at birth, and right STG GMV was negatively correlated with birth age and positively correlated with the proportion of looking at faces and mouths in preterm toddlers at 18 months.
